exercises.explanationUz:
7-8-UNITLAR TESTI - 20 savol.

  PRESENT PERFECT: 1 have GONE
    (hali qaytmagan), 6 never BEEN
    (borib kelgan), 14 have MADE,
    18 Has John ever HAD
  YET / ALREADY / SINCE / FOR: 2
    ... YET? (savol), 7 She's
    ALREADY tidied, 10 SINCE 1980,
    12 FOR more than four hours,
    17 SINCE 1992
  PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS: 5
    HAS been sleeping, 8 Have you
    been WORKING, 15 have been
    FIXING
  PAST PERFECT: 3 HAD already put
    up ... when, 9 She HAD gone
    (wasn't - o'tgan), 11 had never
    EATEN, 13 by the time I GOT,
    20 had GRADUATED
  PAST SIMPLE: 4 We TOOK (last
    night), 19 When DID Matt buy?
  PAST CONTINUOUS: 16 mother WAS
    baking

  ⚠ GONE = ketgan (hali u yerda);
  BEEN = borib kelgan.


⚠ 'MUMPS':

  = tepki (kasallik).

A: What did you do last night? B: We ___ the children to the funfair.
The baby ___ been sleeping all afternoon.
We have never ___ to Berlin. Have you?
She's ___ tidied her room but she hasn't watered the plants.
Have you been ___ here long?
Kate wasn't at the library. She ___ gone home.
They haven't travelled abroad ___ 1980.
I had never ___ Chinese food before I went to China.
A: How long have they been fishing? B: ___ more than four hours.
Jim hadn't finished cooking by the time I ___ home.

tasks.prompt: I have ___ this dress myself. Do you like it?
A: Why are your clothes so dirty? B: I have been ___ the car.

I have been a dancer ___ 1992.
A: Has John ever ___ mumps? B: Yes, he has.
A: When ___ Matt buy his new car? B: Two months ago.
By the time she was 23 years old she had ___ from university.

exercises.explanationUz:
7-8-UNITLAR TAKRORI - 20 ta
  bo'shliq.

  PRESENT PERFECT so'zlari:
    hasn't gone back YET; Have you
    EVER had mumps?; has been in
    Rio FOR three weeks; haven't
    smoked SINCE last month; How
    LONG have you been working?
  PAST PERFECT so'zlari: had
    ALREADY left; had NEVER eaten;
    had JUST mopped; had cooked
    BEFORE guests arrived
  Uy ishlari: Have you MADE your
    bed?; TOO tired to do the
    ironing
  Salomatlik/xavf: KEEP medicines
    away; You'll BURN your finger;
    comes ON duty; helped John TO
    safety; couldn't SAY a word;
    searched FOR the ring
  Boshqa: SORRY I didn't call;
    except FOR James; WHEN was the
    last time?


⚠ 'MUMPS':

  = tepki (kasallik).


⚠ 'TO BE ON DUTY':

  = navbatchilikda bo'lmoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
7-8-UNITLAR LUG'ATI VA
  GRAMMATIKASI.

  1 didn't go out UNTIL it had
    stopped = to'xtaguncha
  2 EXHIBITS in a museum =
    eksponatlar
  3 I'm AFRAID I can't = afsuski
  4 a SCHOOL of whales = kitlar
    to'dasi
  5 deep in THOUGHT = o'yga botgan
  6 What's WRONG, John? = nima
    bo'ldi?
  7 GUIDED tours = gid bilan sayohat
  8 The boat started to SINK =
    cho'ka boshladi
  9 a BROKEN bone = singan suyak
  10 She WAS HAVING coffee when ...
    (past continuous)


⚠ HAYVON TO'DALARI:

  a flock of birds/sheep; a herd of
  cows/elephants; a school of
  whales/fish.


⚠ 'TWISTED':

  = burilgan (ankle - to'piq).

exercises.explanationUz:
RUXSAT, UZR, SALOMATLIK
  DIALOGLARI.

  1 'No, you can't' → Can I go to
    the park?
  2 Uzrga javob → Never MIND. That's
    OK.
  3 'terrible earache' → What's THE
    MATTER / WRONG, Jenny?
  4 'Sure' → Is IT OK IF I play?
  5 'toothache' → Why DON'T YOU GO
    TO the dentist?


⚠ 'NEVER MIND':

  = hechqisi yo'q.


⚠ 'EARACHE' / 'TOOTHACHE':

  = quloq og'rig'i / tish og'rig'i.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Betdagi go, take, eat, make, have.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + have/has + gone / been + to + JOY
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mary's parents have gone to the opera. We have never been to Berlin.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Merining ota-onasi operaga ketishgan. Biz hech qachon Berlinda bo'lmaganmiz.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + had + V3 + by the time / when / before + O'TGAN
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Penny had already put up the tent when Jim started the fire. I had never eaten Chinese food before I went to China.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jim olov yoqqanida Penni chodirni tikib bo'lgan edi. Xitoyga borishdan oldin hech qachon xitoy taomini yemagan edim.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They have been fishing for more than four hours. I have been a dancer since 1992.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular to'rt soatdan ko'proq baliq ovlashyapti. Men 1992-yildan beri raqqosman.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + has/have (not) + V3 + yet / already / just / ever / for / since
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She hasn't gone back to work yet. He has been in Rio for three weeks.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U hali ishga qaytmadi. U uch haftadan beri Rioda.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + had (already/just/never) + V3 + before/when + O'TGAN ZAMON
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She had cooked dinner before her guests arrived. She had just mopped the floor when the dog came in.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin u ovqat pishirgan edi. It kirganda u endigina polni yuvgan edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Can I ...? / Is it OK if I ...? → Sure. / No, you can't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is it OK if I play on my computer? - Sure.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's the matter / wrong? - I've got terrible earache. - Why don't you go to the doctor?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's the matter, Jenny? - I've got terrible earache.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nima bo'ldi, Jenni? - Qulog'im qattiq og'riyapti.
